Volume: 480x480x294 voxels, 1 mm isotropic. Budgets: max 40 tool calls / 15 model prompts / 10 min wall time.
Start with `seg_open`. Finish with `seg_finish`.

Central bulky lobulated T2-bright mass with lateral satellite nodule and thin contiguous fascial tails superiorly/inferiorly included; anterior pelvic vessels/bowel excluded.
